name: Education Edition
description:
Minecraft Education features for Java Edition.

Chemistry: all 118 elements, compounds, and the Compound Creator, Material Reducer, Element Constructor and Lab Table, plus balloons, glow sticks, sparklers, colored torches, underwater TNT, ice bombs, bleach and medicines.

Classroom: chalkboards, NPCs, Allow, Deny and Border blocks, World Builder, the Camera and Portfolio, and the Agent.

Code Builder: press C to code with MakeCode for Minecraft in a web browser.

Turn it on with the Education Edition option when creating a world, or with /gamerule edu:education_features true. The Chemistry Guide book explains it all in game.
